scientific_queries.note: Read-only audit of the four verification items the objective names: drug-by-cell cross, target engagement, independent endpoints, replication.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round measures resource facts that had been treated as premises and finds two of them unmet.

drug_by_cell_cross.imbalance: keys per cell 288 to 1275, cells per combo 28 to 124
drug_by_cell_cross.consequence: claims aggregated across cells inherit this pattern

target_engagement.detail: annotation only, no binding or occupancy measurement

genetic_perturbation.detail: no CRISPR or RNAi data on this machine

independent_endpoints.detail: the four delta metrics are four scalings of one viability readout

the_self_implication.problem: many rounds describe results as passing on two criteria, the boolean flag and the delta EMAX quartile, but those correlate at about 0.83
the_self_implication.effect: phrases like '2 of 3 criteria' overstate the evidence, since the second criterion adds little beyond the first
the_self_implication.what_still_holds: the frozen claim rests on one criterion plus controls that are independent of criterion choice (random block, permuted mapping, dead-block zero), so it is not weakened
the_self_implication.going_forward: report one criterion and its controls instead of counting criteria as replications

what_this_resource_cannot_answer.reproducibility: only for the three percent of observations measured twice
what_this_resource_cannot_answer.what_it_can_answer: decision value inside the dataset, which is exactly the frozen claim

limits: covers only the two resources on this machine
coverage structure examined at tissue and combo level only
the metric correlation is statistical; it does not prove biological identity, but it does rule out treating them as independent checks
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: rewrite every '2 of 3 criteria' phrasing in the synthesis and register as redundancy at rho of 0.83, not replication

register_updates.C98: new: the resource facts and the criterion-redundancy finding
